text: うでに　おぼえが　あるなら　トレーナータワーに　いってみたら？

structure.jp: うでに　おぼえが　あるなら
structure.en: if you're confident in your skills

structure.jp: トレーナータワーに　いってみたら？
structure.en: why not try going to Trainer Tower?

patterns.name: 〜なら
patterns.explanation: なら after a verb means 'if that is the case'. おぼえが　あるなら = 'if you have confidence'.

patterns.name: 〜たらどうか
patterns.explanation: Ending a sentence on たら with a rising voice is a friendly suggestion, short for 'how about if you did'. いってみたら = 'why not try going?'

patterns.name: 〜てみる
patterns.explanation: てみる after a verb means doing it to see how it goes. いってみたら = 'how about trying going'.
